title: Largest File
description: A workspace is unexpectedly large. One nested file is the main cause.
mission: Find the largest file and write its relative path into answer.txt.

lesson.what_happened: Recursive file-size inspection isolated the file consuming most space.
lesson.be_careful: Sparse files and apparent size can differ from allocated disk usage.

hints: Search files recursively and compare sizes.
find can execute du for every file.
